sources.snippet: Characteristics Shumailov et al. [9] coined the term to describe two specific stages to the degradation of machine learning models: early model collapse and late model collapse: In early model collapse, the model begins losing information about the tails of the distribution - mostly affecting minority data.

sources.title: Temporal quality degradation in AI models | Scientific Reports
sources.snippet: In this study, we present the first analysis of AI "aging": the complex, multifaceted phenomenon of AI model quality degradation as more time passes since the last model training cycle.
